decisions.statement: A call is counted once however many transcripts have that call.
A resumed session writes down again the calls made before that session.
A call is the same call wherever its identifier is written.
The calls a subagent made are counted with the calls of the seat above that subagent.
A model this module has no price for is named rather than counted at nothing.
A call moving no token is not counted.
A cache write is priced by the life that write was made for.
A cache write stating no life is priced as the shorter life.
The window ends at the moment of asking and runs back the days said.
The transcripts sit on this machine.
A call made on another machine is not counted.
A price is the api's charge rather than a subscription's cost.

definition: what the transcripts on this machine have, priced at the api's own list price
